notes.title: The Traveler's Path - Steam Puzzle Fest
notes.notes:
🚨 Attention, puzzle lovers! 🧩 

We're excited to announce that our newest game, The Traveler's Path, is now part of the Steam Puzzle Fest! And the good news doesn't end there: you can still grab it at a 20% discount. 

Join the adventure of a young explorer and help him navigate through challenging puzzles. Don't miss out on this opportunity to immerse yourself in a world of puzzle-solving and adventure. 

Get your copy of The Traveler's Path now, now to enjoy solo or challenge a friend, and let the journey begin!



Check out our others great puzzle games at discounted prices:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513310/Blockee__Sliding_Puzzle
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1745710/Cato_the_cat/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231550/The_Travelers_Path/

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Here are the improvements we've made:

[*] Fixed bugs in level 46
